# Convention freeze

| Item | Frozen choice |
|---|---|
| Geometry | SU(2) is the unit three-sphere |
| Class angle | `theta in [0,pi]`, equal to distance from identity |
| Haar radial law | `(2/pi) sin(theta)^2 dtheta` |
| Generator | `(1/2) Delta`, with nonpositive Delta |
| Casimir | `n(n+2)` on the dimension `n+1` representation |
| Action | `s_t=-log p_t`; additive time constants are derivative-inert |

No theorem or certificate uses an alternate normalization.
